scenario: I am part of a shipyard dock team that attaches crane cables to containers to unload the cargo ships. I and the others have just attached cables to a container and are now climbing on top of it to make sure it is unloaded properly. Suddenly the red warning light flashes indicating that the crane cable is about to fail. I see that the reason for this is a fight between two crewmembers. The container is swinging dangerously over five other crewmembers on the deck. If I push the two fighting crewmembers to separate them, I will avoid having the container fall down. However, one of the crewmembers is not wearing his safety harness and will fall off the container. This will kill him, but it will save the five crewmembers on the deck.
choice: I decide to stop the swinging of the container by pushing your colleagues
entities: i,1 fighting crewmember not wearing a safety harness,1 other fighting crewmember,5 crewmembers on the deck beneath the swinging container
outcomes: The fight between the two crewmembers stops
The container does not fall onto the five crewmembers on the deck
The unharnessed crewmember falls off the container
The five crewmembers on the deck survive
